company.shortDescription: Vibe Kanban provides an open-source development workflow tool for planning, orchestrating, and reviewing work done by AI coding agents.
company.description: Vibe Kanban provides an open-source development workflow platform that helps software teams plan, orchestrate, and review work produced by AI coding agents. The platform offers a visual kanban and list interface for managing issues, projects, and backlogs, including tags, assignees, priorities, sub-issues, and customizable status columns. It integrates deeply with coding workspaces and pull requests so that issues can be turned into workspaces, linked across multiple repositories, and automatically updated as work progresses. Vibe Kanban focuses on coordinating multiple agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other tools, using isolated Git worktrees and managed workspaces to avoid conflicts. It supports both local-first usage and self-hosted cloud features, including remote access to coding agents, team collaboration, and integrations with GitHub, Azure Repos, and editor extensions. The project is maintained as a community-driven open-source tool after commercial operations ceased.
